title: stelis molleturoi
intro: Stelis molleturoi, commonly known as the orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Stelis molleturoi include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress.
